description: An open-source Python application released via Open Data LMU that uses a pretrained convolutional neural network to support dental students' self-paced cephalometric landmark-tracing practice with automated comparison and deviation feedback.
title: MCAT (Munich Cephalometric Application for Training)

description: The MCC 360 UGME is a Medical Council of Canada–adapted multisource feedback assessment tool for third-year clerkship students that gathers patient, self, and mixed clinical-rater feedback into an individualized report with facilitated review.
title: MCC 360 UGME

description: MCD-v2 is a computerized adaptive cognitive diagnostic test developed by Vy Le et al.
title: MCD-v2

description: McGraw-Hill Connect is a commercial web-based courseware and assignment platform that includes the LearnSmart adaptive-learning tool for tailoring practice, feedback, and progression to learners' demonstrated performance.
title: McGraw-Hill Connect

description: A validated qualitative scale created by McMaster University researchers for assessing the visual and tactile fidelity of embalmed tissues used in surgical skills training.
title: McMaster Embalming Scale (MES)
